sentences.text: We note from the additional affidavit which has been placed on record that the petitioner asserts ownership of the land in terms of a registered Sale Deed dated 16 June 1988.
Reference has also been placed upon the Khatoni issued on 29 March 1997 as well as the Khasra Girdawri issued on 23 January 1998.

It is on the aforesaid basis that the petitioner asserts that he was the rightful owner of the land in question which ultimately came to be acquired and had attained such rights prior to 27 October 1999 when the Section 4 notification under the Act was issued.
5. In the light of the additional material which has been placed on the record, we deem it expedient to grant time to the LAC as well as DDA to respond to the additional affidavit.
6. Let the said affidavit be filed within a period of three weeks from today.
DDA while filing its response to the additional affidavit shall also place on the record all relevant material in support of its assertion that compensation had been tendered in accordance with law.

7. Let this petition be called again on 01.02.2024.
YASHWANT VARMA, J.
RAVINDER DUDEJA, J.
NOVEMBER 17, 2023/kk
